title: Cross-Border Remittance Analytics & Corridor Intelligence
thesis: Snowflake ingests remittance transactions via Kinesis in real-time, builds corridor analytics with Dynamic Tables, monitors flow anomalies, and provides natural language intelligence for remittance operations — replacing fragmented legacy systems

talking_points: ₱1.8 trillion processed in 90 days across 210 corridors serving 10M+ OFW families.
Saudi Arabia corridor up 14% — Eid al-Fitr seasonal spike.
Three corridors flagged anomalous: UAE, Hong Kong, Japan — volume 3x above rolling average.
tabs.call_out: ₱1.8T in 90 days — 3 corridors flagged for unusual activity

transition.line: Let's drill into corridor performance and what's driving the anomalies.

talking_points: Saudi Arabia is largest corridor at ₱320B — 14% QoQ growth driven by Ramadan/Eid.
ML.FORECAST predicts US corridor will peak Dec 15-25 — Christmas remittance surge.
FX margin compression in UAE corridor: competitors offering 0.2% better rates.
show: Display forecast for US corridor with Christmas peak
tabs.call_out: Christmas surge predicted Dec 15-25 — prepare liquidity now

transition.line: Forecasting seasonal patterns is critical. Let's look at the payout network.

talking_points: 14,500 payout points — banks, pawnshops (Cebuana, Palawan Express), e-wallets (GCash, Maya).
E-wallet payouts now 42% of volume — up from 28% last year.
Door-to-door settlement averaging 18 hours — above 12-hour target in Mindanao.

transition.line: Let the COO ask the system directly.

talking_points: Carmen asks: 'What's our market share in the Saudi corridor?'
Cortex Analyst queries BSP data: 18.3% market share, #2 behind Western Union.
Follow-up: 'What does BSP say about new digital remittance regulations?' — searches regulatory docs.
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + regulatory search

talking_points: Kinesis → Snowpipe Streaming → Dynamic Tables → ML → Cortex Agent — end-to-end.
2.4M transactions processed with sub-5-minute latency from source to dashboard.
OFW remittances: $36B annually. This platform processes ₱1.8T quarterly.
